TaskDescription: Intraoperative microelectrode recording (MER) at one depth of a Ben-gun microelectrode trajectory during awake DBS surgery; this run is the single segment the authors' signal-quality classifier kept from that recording (not the full recording)
Instructions: n/a (awake surgery under local anaesthesia; no task)

ButterworthBandpass.Description: Authors' parser (codes/parser/utils.py): overflow correction, 4th-order Butterworth band-pass 500-5000 Hz (scipy.signal.lfilter, causal), amplitude clipped to +-500 instrument units; applies to the preprocessed channel only

AcquisitionSystem.Description: ISIS MER hardware band-pass; per-site settings (e.g. HW-fcHP 0 Hz, HW-fcLP 5000 Hz) are in the protocol files in sourcedata

ManufacturersModelName: ISIS MER system (MicroMacro electrodes, Ben-gun MicroDrive)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Up to five parallel microelectrodes in a Ben-gun configuration (central, anterior, posterior, medial, lateral) advanced along the planned trajectory; depth relative to the reference target (0 mm = target)
